name: sound-notifs
description: Plays a sound when you submit a message, on errors, when Claude needs your input, and when it finishes working. Sounds come from swappable sound packs.

pack.title: Sound pack
pack.description: Name of the sound pack directory to use (see /sounds list).

volume.title: Sound volume
volume.description: Master volume in percent: 0 is silent, 100 plays sounds as recorded, up to 400.

packsDir.title: Sound packs directory
packsDir.description: Where your own sound packs live. Empty means ~/.claude/sound-packs.

onSubmit.title: Sound on submit
onSubmit.description: Play a sound when you submit a message.

onError.title: Sound on error
onError.description: Play a sound when Claude cannot continue because the turn failed.

onPrompt.title: Sound on prompt
onPrompt.description: Play a sound when Claude asks a question or needs a permission.

onDone.title: Sound on done
onDone.description: Play a sound when Claude has finished working, background agents included.
